summary: Public scaffold for organizing the assessor's plan of assessment around assessment actions, level, quality, uniformity, field-review scheduling, and retention.
plain_language: This is the shell for the plan you will later populate with county-specific review areas, model priorities, and staffing assumptions.

steps.step: Define classes/subclasses and review areas needing assessment action.
Tie each action to level, quality, uniformity, field review, sales review, or data-integrity objectives.
Map planned actions to the annual assessment calendar and six-year inspection cycle.
Preserve plan adoption, amendment, county board submission, and PAD submission records under Schedule 14.
Reserve internal inserts for county-specific neighborhoods, land tables, sales periods, CAMA reports, and staffing plans.

source_refs.locator: Item 14-2 Assessor's Plan of Assessment Report
source_refs.citation: Nebraska Secretary of State Records Management Division, Schedule 14 County Assessors.
